sources.title: DeepSeek R1 Explained: The 2025 Reasoning Model, Benchmarks, Setup, and ...
sources.snippet: DeepSeek R1 is an open-source / open-weight reasoning model family from DeepSeek designed for complex math, coding, and logic tasks. It gained attention because DeepSeek released the model weights, technical report, and distilled variants, making advanced chain-of-thought-style reasoning more accessible to developers, researchers, and businesses.
